notes: Covers the HRN216 type VLA: a 21-inch mower with Smart Drive variable-speed rear-wheel drive and electric start, described in the 2021-and-later engine-label owner's manual. Honda's quick reference gives the same blades, air filter and recoil starter for every HRN216 from serial MANA 1000001 up; the electric-start battery is sold as Honda 31500-VH7-V31 (chemistry and capacity unknown).

gaps: Torque is not given in the manual and no horsepower is stated, so no rated power is set.

The battery is listed as Honda 31500-VH7-V31 but the manual never states its voltage, chemistry or capacity (it only calls for a 12 volt charger and says the float charger holds 13.6 V), so no battery part is claimed.
The ignition coil is named only in the emission-warranty list, which is generic to Honda power equipment engines (it also names oxygen sensors and fuel injectors), so it was left out.
The carburetor has no part number; it is shown on the manual's parts and controls page.
The manual does not name a starter motor (only an electric starter and its circuit), so no motor claim is made.

The wheel/tire part numbers 44710-VR8-N00 (front) and 42710-VR8-N00 (rear) are listed, but no bearing is shown in them, so they were not mapped to bearings; the maintenance schedule names transmission axle bearings with no part number.
The recoil starter is listed by one part number; its spring is not listed on its own.
The manual gives no quantities for the wheels or cables.
The PKA, VKA and VYA types were not read.
method: Honda HRN216 owner's manual, VLA type, 2021 and later engine label, form 00X31-VR8-B203 (28-page PDF): pages 3, 8-9, 11, 14-15 (spark plug, battery, fuses), 19 (specifications), 21 (parts list) and 23 (emission warranty).
Honda Lawn Mower Quick Reference Guide, OTR54649B (2019), page 1: the HRN216 row (serial MANA 1000001 and up) for the blades, air filter and recoil starter, and the spark plug note.
Honda HRN series owner's manuals page: lists the VLA type with this manual (form 00X31VR8B203, serial MANA 1358705 and up) and the quick reference.
Honda's online parts catalogue (exploded diagrams) was not opened.

comps.spec: Honda GCV170 engine: 166 cc (10.1 cu in), 4-stroke overhead-valve single, air-cooled, bore and stroke 60 x 59 mm, 8.0:1 compression, transistorized magneto ignition
Spark plug NGK BPR5ES, Honda 98079-55846, gap 0.7 to 0.8 mm (0.028 to 0.031 in)
Blade set of one lower and one upper blade: Honda 72511-VR8-M00 (lower) and 72531-VR8-M00 (upper); two blade bolts 90105-VA3-J01 torqued to 36 to 43 ft-lb
Carburetor on the GCV170 engine, shown on the manual's parts and controls page (no part number given)
Fuel tank, capacity 0.24 US gal (0.91 L)
Recoil starter, Honda 28400-Z9L-004 (quick reference HRN216 row, serial MANA 1000001 and up)
Smart Drive variable-speed transmission driving the rear wheels, ground speed 0 to 4.11 mph (0 to 1.84 m/s)
Blade control cable and Smart Drive cable (no part numbers given)
30 A main-line fuse for the electric starter circuit and battery, Honda 38201-VH7-S30
3 A fuse on the battery charge line, Honda 38206-V15-003
